topic: Legacy MP4 fragment base addressing without tfhd explicit base or default-base-is-moof
observation: The W3C byte-stream format accepts a single traf with first-trun data offset and no base-data-offset-present flag as movie-fragment-relative addressing. The current parser rejects tfhd with neither explicit base nor default-base-is-moof before considering traf order. No reproducer/test or fix yet; no improvement accepted.
next_steps: Author a single-traf owned VP9 control with explicit moof flag and an otherwise identical legacy implicit-base witness; reproduce opening/playback refusal.
Cover per-traf preceding-data-end continuity, mixed explicit/implicit bases and skipped foreign tracks before changing the base algorithm.
Retain malformed offset and resource refusal tests, then verify both parsers and native seek/playback.
